texts.error.missing_file: The game file %1 is missing (from the Syndicate Plus CD, SYNDICAT\DATA).
texts.error.no_arena: There is no memory for the game's arena.
texts.error.no_stack: There is no memory for the game's stack.
texts.error.too_many_files: The game opened too many files.
texts.firmware.data_file.about: Syndicate Plus CD (EA/Bullfrog 1994): %1. You have to supply it. The package contains none of the game's data. A modified file of your own can be used instead, and the project records exactly which file it was.
texts.property.level_seed: The random seed: seed*0x24A1+0x24DF each draw; loaded with the mission from GAMExx.DAT
texts.property.mission: The mission being played (the game's level number)
texts.property.steps: Steps run: one pass of the game's loop each, 1/16 s
texts.property.turns: Turns of a mission's game loop run so far
texts.setting.language.about: The game's language (the original '-c' option). The menus come from SyndicatFX's translations, and the mission briefings from the CD's own sets. It changes the game (its texts and layout), so a movie records it.
texts.setting.sound.about: The sound card chosen in the game's setup. 'Sound Blaster' is the default and the only card the game supports. Its digitized sounds play one at a time, as on the card, and the music plays on its FM chip through the game's own driver. 'None' is no card (the original '-s' option). The game waits for its song to end before a won or lost mission ends, so the choice changes the game, and a movie records it.
